list.title: Configuración general
list.description: 2026 doctrine versions of pension calculation parameters

current.title: Active doctrine
current.description: These 2026 doctrine parameters are used for all new calculations. Each persisted calculation freezes the version used.

create.title: New doctrine version
create.description: Publish a new version of the general configuration. The previous version is automatically deactivated.
create.error: An error occurred while publishing the version

delete.title: Delete inactive version
delete.description: Confirmar eliminación de la versión inactiva
delete.confirm: This action is irreversible. Only inactive versions can be deleted.
delete.error: An error occurred while deleting the version

form.combatant_threshold_date_help: Date separating combatants before (PAU) from after (PPU). Typically 1959-01-01.
form.pre_threshold_percent_help: Fraction [0–1] applied to combatants with income before FUC
form.post_threshold_percent_help: Fraction [0–1] applied to combatants with income on or after FUC
form.internationalist_increment_help: Absolute amount added to the amount when the applicant is an internationalist
form.minimum_pension_help: Minimum amount of the pension. If below, the IPmin increment is applied
form.maximum_pension_help: Absolute cap of the pension. Must be ≥ minimum pension
form.minimum_pension_increment_help: Absolute amount added when the pension falls below PMin
